snippet.title: Drillbird Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Drillbird is a Digging Platformer where you play as a bird with a drill as its beak, drilling your way through the world to find ores in order to make your egg hatch.

Context: The games company I worked at shut down last November, so I made a lil game to cope, and here it is! It's free, and pretty neat imo! I hope yall like it. 

You can play it in your browser, or download it for better performance on PC or Mac. 
Play it here: https://mnniska.itch.io/drillbird
